title: Calling Cards
summary: Business cards for a food trading brand, a newspaper publisher and a local supplier.
description: A set of calling cards designed for small businesses, each matched to its industry: navy and gold for Noor Food Products Trading, a newsprint motif for The Southern Tagalog Herald, and stone textures for a gravel and sand supplier.

images.caption: Halal Food Mockup
images.alt: Mockup of a stack of navy Noor Halal Food and Trading calling cards for Ruby Allen F. Leonor, beside a white back card reading "Guaranteed Pure and Fresh". Contact details are blurred.

images.caption: Purple Card Mockup
images.alt: Mockup of a purple Noor's Halal Gourmet Food & Trading calling card for Ruby Allen F. Leonor, lying on beige fabric. Contact details are blurred.

images.caption: Noor Back
images.alt: Back of the Noor Food Products Trading calling card: a gold Noor logo on navy.

images.caption: Noor Owner
images.alt: Front of the Noor calling card for owner Ruby Allen F. Leonor, with a gold wing motif on navy. Contact details are blurred.

images.caption: Gravel And Sand
images.alt: Calling card for Elmer T. Masambique, Gravel and Sand, with a stone texture and a list of gravel and sand products. Contact details are blurred.

images.caption: Herald Publisher
images.alt: Calling card for Nena E. Mallari, publisher and owner of The Southern Tagalog Herald Publications, with a rolled-up newspaper. Contact details are blurred.
